resources.string: The matrix describes built-in product capabilities, not the current switch state. Turning a semantic service off keeps syntax highlighting, keywords, snippets, and local completion at the level shown here.

The file-type list is the first language-service allowlist. A file must match a selected suffix before semantic routing is considered. Selecting a custom suffix does not reinterpret it as another language. Semantic features additionally require a recognized language, an available provider, and that language\'s switch to be on.

Each switch affects only its recognized language family and is also gated by the global LSP switch and file-type allowlist. Turning a service off preserves syntax and local completion. Kotlin remains visible but disabled because it provides P2+ local completion without a semantic provider.
